findings.claim: The frank-projects subtree contains 14 project folders but they are not 14 equivalent executable applications. They separate into executable-source/partial pipelines, plan/research-only projects, browser/task scaffolds, a static website, and a trivial stub.
findings.implication: ClayCode general-purpose evaluation must classify source maturity before reuse; project-folder count is not executable-application count.

findings.claim: ev-scout-graz provides reusable host-reference behavior for file-backed state, dedupe, deterministic scoring and HTTP-client scanner structure. Selected ev_scorer.py and ev_scanner.py parse successfully; isolated local runtime probes passed deterministic scoring and JSON add/dedupe/save/reload behavior without invoking external network scans.
findings.implication: Use these historical sources as APP-01/HTTP-client/state differential fixtures when implementing ClayCode parser/runtime/stdlib/FFI. The historical Python result is an oracle input, not ClayCode acceptance by itself.

findings.claim: autoscout-e-car-hunter contains a real multi-file process pipeline: autoscout_hunter.py invokes scoring_engine.py and contact_agent.py as subprocesses, consumes JSON artifacts and emits an executive summary; its code subtree also contains scoring/contact modules.
findings.implication: Provides a concrete reference fixture for CLI orchestration, files, subprocess/resource effects and failure propagation under explicit capability authority.

findings.claim: autocarfinder-pro's search agent is syntactically executable but explicitly notes that its HTML extraction is simplified and a real implementation needs an HTML parser; several other project folders are plans or browser traces with little/no executable code.
findings.implication: Compiler/application tests must distinguish syntax validity from semantic/application completeness and preserve incomplete-source fixtures as expected-failure/repair cases.

findings.claim: video-launch-page contains a concrete responsive HTML/CSS static landing page, but no backend/server path in the inspected source. The fixed ClayCode acceptance contract explicitly states a frontend-only static generator cannot replace APP-02 HTTP server/routing/backend proof.
findings.implication: Reuse the page as frontend/static asset output for APP-02, while building a new ClayCode HTTP server/backend around it rather than claiming the historical page satisfies APP-02.

findings.claim: The sampled historical project corpus supplies useful CLI/files/process/HTTP-client/static-website/state fixtures but does not provide evidence for a real DB-backed service, concurrent service, executable GUI, compiler/tool, GPU/ML backend, FRANK component or full FRANK handoff.
findings.implication: Do not narrow the mandatory ClayCode application suite to what the archive happens to contain; missing APP classes remain new executable obligations.

claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-01: Reuse ev-scout-graz/autoscout pipeline behavior as host-reference and mutation corpus; still require Clay compile/lower/execute receipt.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-02: Reuse video-launch-page HTML as frontend asset fixture; HTTP server/routing/state/backend must be newly executed in ClayCode.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-03: JSON persistence does not satisfy DB service; real DB adapter/transaction path remains open.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-04: No historical concurrent-service proof found in bounded corpus; remains new work.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-05: No executable GUI proof found; remains new work.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-06: No compiler/interpreter proof found; remains new work.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-07: No GPU/ML/numerical proof found; remains new work.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-08: Subprocess orchestration supplies a harmless process-effect reference but not full low-level/admin/device proof.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-09: No FRANK component in this subtree; use FRANK sources elsewhere.
claycode_acceptance_feedback.APP-10: No full FRANK handoff evidence in this subtree.

branch_feedback.claycode: Seed BASE application proof development with the real historical project corpus rather than toy-only examples, but keep acceptance strict: each reused source becomes an oracle/counterexample and must be re-expressed, compiled and executed in ClayCode.
branch_feedback.harness: Add project-maturity classifier and expected-failure fixtures so plan-only/browser-only/incomplete prototypes cannot be counted as executable evidence. Preserve host reference outputs for differential testing.
branch_feedback.q12_index: frank-projects direct denominator is 14 projects; bounded application-semantic classification is complete, nested support-artifact semantics remain open.

earned_work_candidate.mechanism_or_result: Historical real-project corpus plus executable host-reference fixtures reduce application-example design/search effort and provide concrete negative maturity cases for the ClayCode general-purpose gate.
earned_work_candidate.falsifier_or_validation_receipt: ClayCode BASE must actually reuse at least two of these host-reference fixtures in differential executable tests; otherwise remove avoided-hours credit.

progress_accounting.reason: This closes the 14-project direct application-classification denominator and selected runtime probes, not all nested support files nor the whole Drive/PF/cross-source denominator.
